name: @gohighlevel/marketplace-cli
description: Command-line interface for the GoHighLevel marketplace developer portal — build, configure, and publish marketplace apps from the terminal
author: HighLevel

scripts.pretest: npm run build && npm run manifest
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run manifest

account.description: List and switch between developer accounts available to the active login

app.description: Manage apps in your developer account (create, configure, publish)

app:keys.description: OAuth client keys — each key is a client id + one-time secret pair

app:scopes.description: OAuth scopes the app requests at install time

app:redirect.description: OAuth redirect URIs for the app's authorization flow

app:webhook.description: Webhook URL and event subscriptions (events unlock based on scopes)

app:actions.description: JSON-first workflow actions, action versions, validation, and synchronization

app:triggers.description: JSON-first workflow triggers, trigger versions, validation, and synchronization

app:pricing.description: Billing model (free, paid, freemium) and pricing plans

app:billing.description: JSON-first subscription plans, usage meters, validation, and synchronization

app:billing:plan.description: Marketplace subscription plans stored in src/billing/subscription.json

sandbox.description: Sandbox agency accounts for testing apps (one active per developer)

secrets.description: One-time secrets (client secrets, SSO keys, sandbox passwords) captured by this CLI
